problem: The rule 'It must fall, never rise' contradicts the rest of the chapter. An SLD read from source (generator at 11–25 kV) to load must show the voltage RISING at the step-up transformer before it falls at the step-down substations and the distribution transformer. As written, a student would mark the correct step-up transformer as an error.
fix: Voltage rises once, at the step-up transformer, and then falls at every step-down substation and at the distribution transformer. A rise where a step-down is expected means an arrow or a winding symbol is reversed.

problem: The figure chain is not consistent with the text chain. The step-down substation is noted '66/33 kV', which skips the first 400/220 kV stage, and the next node is already the 11 kV feeder, skipping 33/11 kV. The step-up note '220 kV' also differs from the text, which gives 400/220/132 kV.
fix: Use notes that do not imply missing stages, e.g. step-up '400/220/132 kV', step-down substation 'e.g. 220/66/33 kV', and add or fold in the 33/11 kV stage before the 11 kV feeder.

problem: The list of standard Indian transmission levels leaves out 765 kV, the highest AC level in use, and presents 66 kV as a transmission level, although it is normally classed as subtransmission and is used only in some regions.
fix: Standard AC levels in India are 765 kV, 400 kV, 220 kV, 132 kV and 66 kV; 66 kV is used as subtransmission in some regions, while 132 kV and 33 kV are the common subtransmission levels elsewhere.

problem: The isolator is described only as 'a diagonal line that opens'. A student misses the key operating point that an isolator must not be opened on load.
fix: Isolator: a diagonal line (knife switch), often drawn open. It has no arc-quenching, so it is opened only after the circuit breaker has cleared the current.

problem: 'The delta blocks triplen harmonics' can be read as the delta removing harmonics from the whole transformer. The delta winding actually gives the triplen (third-harmonic) currents a closed path to circulate, so they do not appear in the line voltages.
fix: The delta winding lets triplen harmonic currents circulate inside it, so they do not reach the line voltages; the star point can be earthed.
